ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 2:3 ratio of high-intensity white pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity contiguous white patches on the distal lateral margins of both lobes. Central medial region and areas adjacent to the trailing edge are dominated by low-intensity pixels with significant small-scale mottling and speckling transitions.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an acute angle of approximately 22 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of approximately 1:2 relative to the notch opening.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular sawtooth edge with approximately 12-14 distinct peaks per lobe and variable pixel amplitudes ranging from 5 to 20 pixels from the mean edge baseline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature observed on the superior trailing margins of both lobes, tapering to irregular contours at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Left lobe: one distinct circular low-intensity ring with a high-intensity center in the upper white quadrant. Right lobe: several discrete, small circular high-contrast spots scattered across the medial and distal high-intensity regions.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct, sub-parallel low-intensity linear streaks visible in the high-intensity white region of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular, high-contrast structural clusters and pixel-level contour disruptions at both distal tips; evidence of structural irregularity at the lobe extremities.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant high-intensity pixel noise caused by water spray and splashing, partially obscuring the lower central boundary of the fluke surface.
